title: Application of Previous Ban on Visitors to Preschools by Parents and Parents of Newly-enrolled Children
what_it_is: Application of Previous Ban on Visitors to Preschools by Parents and Parents of Newly-enrolled Children

sections.label: Preschool visitor entry rules
sections.summary: The passage states when parents, photographers, videographers and prospective parents may enter preschools, while casual visitors remain restricted.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Since November last year, parents can accompany their newly-enrolled children and can do so for half a day for the first two days of preschool.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For children with additional needs, preschools may exercise flexibility and allow these parents to accompany their child for a longer period.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: From 24 November last year, external photographers and videographers were also allowed to enter the preschool for the kindergarten graduation ceremonies.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: From 26 April 2022, parents may enter the preschool to attend parent-teacher conferences or as volunteers.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Prospective parents may also enter the preschool to tour the preschool premises.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: However, casual visitors remain restricted to lower transmission risks, as the majority of preschoolers are ineligible for vaccination.
